author: @Shimaen
text:
Isn't Tawil just adding only 15% more final damage and of course the double play? Most of the final damage is from Ogier E3 -> 150% instead of 100% and Arachne which is like another 150-170% after all pursuits. Also isn't Arachnes wheel just increasing dam amp but the important increase comes from her pursuit as it increases final damage by 10% per pursuit and the singularity stacks from ultra turn that also increase final damage. Final damage is much more useful than damage amp cause it multiplies with the strength scaling.

So basically a budget version would be with e.g. normal Tawil for utility (OE good for extra arith) and Hameln for the double play and you mainly lose the 15% final damage. This is not a lot considering the very high final damage basket, however the combo is at least 2 arith more expansive. Or you just play somehow without double play and instead with someone who can proc the corrosion. Thinking of e.g. the 4 cost of Glotan but maybe this would have arith problems
